name: claude-rooms
description: Multiplayer Claude Code. Two or more developers each running their own Claude Code session, sharing live state of what their agents are doing, in real time.

actor_name.title: Actor name
actor_name.description: Short identifier other teammates see for you in the room. Defaults to your git user.name, kebab-cased. Override here if you want something different.

share_prompts.title: Share your prompts with teammates
share_prompts.description: Share the first 100 characters of each prompt you send with teammates in the room. Default OFF. When enabled, your verbatim prompts will be visible to all teammates in any room you join. Only enable this if you are confident every prompt you type is safe to share.

room_code_length.title: Room code word count
room_code_length.description: How many words to include in a generated room code. 4 is the safe default (~2.8 trillion combinations from the EFF Short Wordlist). Use shorter only on trusted local networks. Range 2-6.

turn_servers.title: Custom TURN servers (JSON)
turn_servers.description: JSON array of RTCIceServer entries to use for WebRTC relay. Example: [{"urls":"turn:my.coturn:3478","username":"u","credential":"p"}]. Replaces the default Open Relay TURN entry. STUN entries from the default are retained.

disable_default_turn.title: Disable the default public TURN relay
disable_default_turn.description: When true, claude-rooms does not configure any TURN server by default. Direct peer-to-peer must succeed (mirrored networking on Windows, no symmetric NAT). When false (default), Open Relay's free anonymous TURN endpoint is used as a fallback. Setting this to true gives you stricter privacy at the cost of not connecting in some network environments.

signaling_servers.title: Custom y-webrtc signaling server URLs (JSON)
signaling_servers.description: JSON array of WebSocket URLs to use as y-webrtc signaling servers. Power-user override; leave unset to use the three community defaults baked into y-webrtc.
